julia-cs: FYI customer reported weird rerank scores — negatives and values that don't sum to 1. Ticket #3245. Pasting minimal repro and response.

julia-cs: customer_payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "query": "find policy docs",
  "candidates": ["docA", "docB", "docC"]
}
```

julia-cs: response snippet: 
```json
{
  "results": [
    {"id": 0, "scores": [-2.31, -0.45, -3.02]}
  ]
}
```

david-ml: This is expected behaviour by default — our rerank API returns raw logits, not normalized probabilities. We avoid auto-softmaxing server-side because some customers need raw scores for downstream math.

julia-cs: The customer assumed scores were probabilities and fed them straight to their UI, so negatives were confusing. They also said re-ordering candidates changed which item was top-ranked.

rahul-sre: Note: we also saw a partial failure earlier for this client (502 on a very large batch) — request_id 01GHI-8923. A retry path could produce different ordering if client relies on batch-level reordering from our SDK. Logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/01GHI-8923

david-ml: Quick repro and fix note: logits can be negative; apply softmax to convert to probabilities. Example (numpy):
```python
import numpy as np
logits = np.array([-2.31, -0.45, -3.02])
exp = np.exp(logits - logits.max())
probs = exp / exp.sum()
# probs ~ [0.10, 0.84, 0.06]
```
This preserves ordering and gives normalized values.

julia-cs: Can we offer a server-side toggle so the customer doesn't have to change client code?

david-ml: We have an internal flag return_prob=true that will return probabilities, but it's not public. Options: (1) flip the flag for this tenant as a short-term patch, (2) add a documented query param score_mode=logits|prob across endpoints. I'll open a docs + API PR for (2) and we can enable (1) if they need immediate help.

rahul-sre: Also add a support note: customers should send stable candidate ids so results can be mapped back after any batching/retries — our runtime may reorder internally for efficiency. That explains the "changed when they reorder candidates" report.

julia-cs: Draft reply to customer: short explainer, paste softmax snippet, suggest stable ids, and offer temporary server-side prob output. Will include request_id and logs.

ops-bot: deploy triggered: docs PR #4092 opened by david-ml — staging build started.

david-ml: Follow-up: create a product ticket to make score_mode official and add code examples across SDKs. Also add a short note in rerank docs clarifying raw_logits default.

julia-cs: Marking as internal action items done; awaiting customer confirmation. Will escalate if they request server-side change. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
